scheme_name: Distance Education Scholarship–Scholarship For Disabled Students Pursuing Degree, PG Courses
other_conditions: Student must be pursuing a degree or postgraduate course through open universities, distance education, or private registration within Kerala
Financial assistance is provided only for students appearing for the exam each year
Further scholarship grants depend on academic progress assessment
Eligibility is lost if the course is discontinued midway
If the number of applicants exceeds available slots, priority is given based on qualifying marks
benefits_summary: Scholarship up to ₹10,000 to cover registration, tuition, exam fees, books and other study materials for the duration of the course.
